messages:
Anna (PM): RCA published -> https://intranet.redwood/rcas/1951234567  TL;DR: cache eviction bug + routing fallback mismatch caused a 32-minute degradation for external inference traffic. No customer data exposed. Summary + timeline + heatmap in the doc. :eyes:

Dave (Infra): Thanks. Quick highlights for exec/CS handoff: 1) outage window 02:13-02:45 UTC, peak error rate 18%. 2) Automatic fallback switches sent traffic to a model variant with incompatible tokenizer config. 3) Rolling retries amplified load on control plane.

Sara (SRE): Added playbook changes in the RCA. Two immediate things from on-call: remove automatic retry amplification (PR #764), and add a circuit-breaker on fallback routing for 5xx spikes.

Miguel (Runtime Eng): Proposed mitigation patch for tokenizer compatibility check is in review: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/2093  If merged, it will block fallback to variants with mismatched tokenizers. ETA for merge: EOD tomorrow.

Priya (Ops): Action owners + deadlines (please ack):
- Action A: Add compatibility gate to fallback logic — owner: Miguel — due: 2026-03-31
- Action B: Circuit-breaker + rate-limited retries — owner: Sara — due: 2026-03-29
- Action C: Post-incident customer comms + summary for Sales — owner: Anna — due: 2026-03-28

Anna (PM): Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept an owner+deadline. I'll post a short exec summary once all acks are in.

Dave (Infra): Acked. I'll also schedule a capacity sweep for dedicated pools to ensure retries don't create cascade failures.

Miguel (Runtime Eng): Acked. Will follow up in PR and add unit test for tokenizer checks.

Sara (SRE): Acked. I'll draft the circuit-breaker design doc and run it by eng-arch Friday.

incident-bot: Incident incident-195123: RCA document uploaded by Anna. Action items created in the tracker: https://incidents.redwood/195123

Anna (PM): Checkpoint schedule (weekly cadence until all actions closed):
- Weekly sync 1: Mon 2026-03-29 10:00 PT (30m) — owners review progress
- Weekly sync 2: Mon 2026-04-05 10:00 PT (30m) — validation and monitoring updates
- Final verification: Wed 2026-04-14 11:00 PT

Anna (PM): If anyone needs the RCA in PDF or an extract for customer-facing teams, ping me and I'll produce a 1-page. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :pray:
